effect_description_eng:
When this card would be played, if your opponent has a Digimon with 11000 DP or more, reduce the cost by 6.
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon may battle 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
[On Deletion] You may play or use 1 Tamer or Option card with the [Boss] or [DATA SQUAD] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Leomon] in name or w/[DATA SQUAD] trait: Cost 4
